output.subject: Thank you for your report about text messages using our name
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for taking the time to contact us, especially as you mentioned that you are not a Meridian Harbor Bank customer. We appreciate you letting us know.

We have received your report. You told us that you keep receiving text messages saying your Meridian account is locked and directing you to a login page through a web link. You mentioned that you believe someone is using our name to scam people, and you wanted us to be aware of it.

A specialist team is reviewing what you have shared, and we will respond within 10 business days.

We understand how unsettling repeated messages like these can be, and we're sorry for the worry and inconvenience they have caused you.

Thank you again for looking out for others by reporting this.

Kind regards,
Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Sender says they are not a customer; confirm whether a full follow-up response is needed or a closing acknowledgement is sufficient.
This is a report rather than a complaint; the customer asked only that the bank be aware.
The reported link (meridianharbor-verify.example.net/login) was deliberately not repeated in the reply; keep it out of customer-facing text.
Decide whether to add the bank's approved guidance on recognizing and reporting phishing messages; none was included since it was not in the report.
Do not confirm or deny in the reply whether the domain or texts are fraudulent until the specialist team has assessed them.
Ensure the reported domain and text details are passed to the team handling impersonation reports.
